windowMap.r2Mechanical: W1: both boundaries inside +-1.5s. W2: open outside (-2.90). W3: both outside (-2.20/-3.43). W4: open outside (-4.87), close inside. Applied as written, all three refill windows carry a boundary outside the +-1.5s montage tolerance -> mechanically DROPPED per R2, and '<2 refill windows survive / all disagree' is the BASIS-BROKEN condition. Laid beside this mechanical result: three instruments independent of the 30fps trace corroborate the TRACE boundaries and localize the disagreement to the pre-registered 1fps map itself - (1) the stage-II countdown digits fix the three countdown spans at ~14.05-24.05, ~38.26-48.26, ~61.50-71.33, each ending 0.55-0.8s (drain animation) before the trace's window-open instants 24.60/48.80/72.13; (2) the hand-montage ammo decrements place each refill window's first pull at 25.07-25.40 / 49.60-49.93 / 72.23-72.57, 0.5-1.6s after the trace opens and 2.1-4.7s BEFORE the map's opens (a pull cannot credit onto an unpainted bar); (3) the full->open cycle length is 10.6-11.1s on all three cycles against the map's implied 9.3-12.5s spread. The map's cast-3 anchor (~64.5) is directly contradicted by countdown digit 09.00 at t=62.5. No verdict attached; the driver/judge decides whether R2's drop indicts the trace or the pre-registered map.
windowMap.r3W4Gate: R3 required W4's pull count hand-montage-verified AND its trace boundaries to reconcile the ~6.5s-fill discrepancy. Montage: 9 pulls open->green-full (6 in magazine 1 at 72.2-77.6, reload, 3 in magazine 2 at 80.6-82.9). Trace boundaries: W4 is 72.13->83.20 = 11.07s, not the map's 6.5s - the 6.5s figure came from the map's late open (77); 11.07s is cadence-consistent (9 x ~1.05s + 2.35s reload + ~0.9s hold). The remaining W4 anomaly is NOT duration but per-pull magnitude: single-pull credits of +16.0 and +15.2 (each confirmed a single ammo decrement), a smeared p7 credit (~+8.0..8.7), and a rendered 100.0 ramp at 81.47-81.63 followed by two clipped pulls before the green full at 83.20.

noiseInput._method: Guard construction IDENTICAL to the C4 spec (docs/probe-data/c4-noise-floor-rerun-2026-08-16.json params): bin 1/30s, event grouping <=2 trace-frames, guard [fireSec - 2 frames, fireSec + 0.30s + 8 frames], widened pulls double both half-widths, quiet bins = in-window filling reads outside all guards and exclusions, spans containing any dominant-curve (offCurve, tol 1.5) flagged read DROPPED whole. fireSec is the guard ANCHOR: credit - 0.30s (the A3 fire->credit latency) for pulls with a clean credit instant; the ammo-bracket midpoint for hidden/smeared/clipped credits (those are widened). Ammo brackets (3fps montage cells) corroborate every anchor within <=0.17s.

series30fpsChangesOnly._reconstruction: reads[i] for i in 0..frameCount-1: t = round(i/30, 2); state/fillRaw = the last change at index <= i. Changes are [frameIndex, state, fillRaw]. Byte-equivalent to the reader's full output (the reader emits every frame; a change row exists wherever consecutive frames differ).
